name: On Air
summary: A Go live button that counts down, flickers a neon ON AIR sign on and fills the room with reactions
about: A podcast studio card with a dark neon sign, live stats and one big Go live button. Pressing it starts a three-second countdown with a ring that drains around the button. Then the tubes flicker on letter by letter, broadcast waves roll off the sign, a red wash fills the room, listeners climb, the mic meter dances and hearts float up. Ending the stream flickers the sign off and pops a saved summary with sparks. It suits live streams, podcasts, webinars and any publish flow with a go-live moment.
how: Press Go live (click, Enter or Space). The button squashes and the countdown 3, 2, 1 punches onto the sign while a ring drains.
Press Cancel or Escape during the countdown to stop it.
At zero the ON AIR tubes flicker on one by one, waves roll out and the REC light blinks.
While live, the timer runs, listeners count up, the mic meter bounces and reactions float up the side.
Press End stream: the sign flickers off, a saved summary pops with sparks and the button rolls back to Go live.
